cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4; TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate @18 is after Parfum @7, so it is not a reinforcing route (C4). Sodium Xylenesulfonate @3 is a hydrotrope, not a route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system - a silicone pair (Dimethiconol @10, Dimethicone @14) with cationic guar (@11) as a coacervate-type conditioning system. C2 not met: no silicone is early (both after Parfum @7), no pearlizing route, the only listed humectant (Panthenol @19) is late. Counter-signal: all conditioning routes are post-E3; neighbor low.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: silicones plus cationic guar plausibly deposit noticeable but bounded residue; no payload lipid, no rich architecture, effective C1 reset.

excluded: Menthol @12, fragrance materials and Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil @24 (fragrance/cooling, 6.4)

weightPotential.counterevidence: Silicones and guar are listed after Parfum @7 and could be small amounts; W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone), so it gives no support either way.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Two plausibly persistent deposition families (silicone, cationic polymer) converge; silicones deposit by dilution deposition even when listed late (W-LINE item: non-lipid families read as v1.6).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: only two families, no payload lipid (W-RICH impossible), no film former or protein, and an effective SLES/betaine reset offsets part of the deposit. Not low: a silicone pair plus guar is more than a single light route (W2). Neighbor high is recorded because the silicone/guar coacervate system is designed to deposit and the two adjacent bands are not clearly unequal toward low (N-ALT, heavier when equally realistic).
